body:
A complete guide to planning and executing effective study sessions.

Set Clear Goals

Define what you need to learn, by when, and what success looks like.

Use Active Recall

Test yourself frequently instead of only re-reading notes.

Spaced Repetition

Review material at increasing intervals to improve long-term memory.

Track Progress

Use weekly review sessions to adjust strategy and close knowledge gaps.
